title: Custom eggless cakes for Rosehill and Camellia — pickup as late as 10pm
summary:
A finished shift in Camellia doesn't leave much time before most bakeries shut. Harris Park stays open until 10pm, seven days a week — pickup included.

The order itself still needs 48 hours minimum notice. That's what fresh baking actually takes, and we don't shortcut it. What changes is when you collect it: after work, after a late train from Parramatta CBD, after the school run in Rosehill. Six sizes, 15 flavours including Rasmalai and Ferrero Rocher — every one 100% eggless, not some.

Order via WhatsApp: +61 425 697 725. Wigram Street, a short drive from Rosehill and Camellia.
